title: The Secret Library
style: cinematic live-action film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, natural light, emotional mood, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: Priya, a young woman in her early twenties, expressive face, long dark hair often tied back, wears vibrant Indian kurti sets or simple sarees.

Rohan.look: A kind-faced young man, mid-twenties, well-built, with a warm smile, always wears neat casual shirts and jeans.

scenes.image: Close-up on Priya's tear-filled eyes, a single tear tracing down her cheek, looking heartbroken. Dark background, soft focus.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mera boyfriend ek secret chupa raha tha. Bohot bada secret.
scenes.sub: My boyfriend was hiding a secret. A very big secret.
scenes.say: मेरा बॉयफ्रेंड एक सीक्रेट छुपा रहा था। बहुत बड़ा सीक्रेट।

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan laughing together, holding hands, walking through a vibrant Indian market, sunlight filtering through.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan aur main ek saal se saath the. Sab perfect tha.
scenes.sub: Rohan and I had been together for a year. Everything was perfect.
scenes.say: रोहन और मैं एक साल से साथ थे। सब परफेक्ट था।

scenes.image: Priya showing Rohan a faded old photograph of a dilapidated building in a small village, both smiling nostalgically.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Bachpan mein, maine use ek sapna bataya tha.
scenes.sub: In childhood, I had told him a dream.
scenes.say: बचपन में, मैंने उसे एक सपना बताया था।

scenes.image: Priya's younger self (flashback), sketching a detailed library on a piece of paper, eyes wide with hope.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Apne gaon mein ek library kholne ka sapna.
scenes.sub: A dream of opening a library in my village.
scenes.say: अपने गाँव में एक लाइब्रेरी खोलने का सपना।

scenes.image: Rohan listening intently, holding Priya's hand, his expression warm and supportive. They are in a cozy cafe.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne kaha tha, 'Hum milkar pura karenge. Hamara sapna.'
scenes.sub: He had said, 'We will fulfill it together. Our dream.'
scenes.say: उसने कहा था, 'हम मिलकर पूरा करेंगे। हमारा सपना।'

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan sitting on a bench, laughing, looking at a beautiful sunset over a lake. Peaceful moment.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Hamara pyaar, hamare plans, sab kuch pura lagta tha.
scenes.sub: Our love, our plans, everything felt complete.
scenes.say: हमारा प्यार, हमारे प्लांस, सब कुछ पूरा लगता था।

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan's hand gently tracing patterns on Priya's palm, a tender moment.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uska touch, uski baatein, sab sukoon deti thi.
scenes.sub: His touch, his words, everything brought peace.
scenes.say: उसका टच, उसकी बातें, सब सुकून देती थी।

scenes.image: Rohan holding Priya in a comforting hug, her head resting on his chest, both looking happy.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh sirf mera pyaar nahi, mera sab kuch tha.
scenes.sub: He was not just my love, he was my everything.
scenes.say: वो सिर्फ मेरा प्यार नहीं, मेरा सब कुछ था।

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan walking hand-in-hand through a park, dappled sunlight, looking carefree.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Zindagi aisi hi achi chal rahi thi. Phir...
scenes.sub: Life was going well like this. Then...
scenes.say: ज़िंदगी ऐसी ही अच्छी चल रही थी। फिर...

scenes.image: Rohan on his phone, looking tense, whispering into the receiver, back turned to Priya. Priya watches him, confused.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan badalne laga. Uske phone calls, late nights.
scenes.sub: Rohan started changing. His phone calls, late nights.
scenes.say: रोहन बदलने लगा। उसके फोन कॉल्स, लेट नाइट्स।

scenes.image: Priya at home, looking at an empty chair where Rohan usually sits, her face thoughtful and a little sad.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh ghar der se aata, kho jaata. Mujhse door.
scenes.sub: He would come home late, lost. Away from me.
scenes.say: वो घर देर से आता, खो जाता। मुझसे दूर।

scenes.image: Priya trying to talk to Rohan, but he's distracted, staring blankly, deep in thought, not hearing her.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Meri baaton ka koi jawab nahi tha. Woh chup rehta.
scenes.sub: There were no answers to my words. He stayed silent.
scenes.say: मेरी बातों का कोई जवाब नहीं था। वो चुप रहता।

scenes.image: Priya watching Rohan walk away from her in their apartment, looking hurt and isolated.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek deewar si ban gayi thi hamare beech.
scenes.sub: A wall had formed between us.
scenes.say: एक दीवार सी बन गई थी हमारे बीच।

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan's hand quickly putting away a wad of cash into his wallet, eyes darting nervously.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek din, maine uske purse mein bohot saare paise dekhe.
scenes.sub: One day, I saw a lot of money in his purse.
scenes.say: एक दिन, मैंने उसके पर्स में बहुत सारे पैसे देखे।

scenes.image: Priya picking up a small, folded train ticket from Rohan's desk, her brow furrowed in suspicion, destination visible: a rural station.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur phir yeh train ticket. Gaon ki taraf. Mere gaon.
scenes.sub: And then this train ticket. Towards the village. My village.
scenes.say: और फिर यह ट्रेन टिकट। गाँव की तरफ। मेरे गाँव।

scenes.image: Priya showing the ticket to her friend (off-screen), looking worried, asking for advice.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe kuch samajh nahi aa raha tha. Shak badhne laga.
scenes.sub: I couldn't understand anything. Doubt started growing.
scenes.say: मुझे कुछ समझ नहीं आ रहा था। शक बढ़ने लगा।

scenes.image: Priya looking at Rohan's phone, seeing frequent calls to an unknown number. Her expression is anxious.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anjaan numbers se call, aur messages. Kiske the woh?
scenes.sub: Calls from unknown numbers, and messages. Whose were they?
scenes.say: अनजान नंबर्स से कॉल, और मैसेजेस। किसके थे वो?

scenes.image: Priya trying to make eye contact with Rohan, but he's avoiding it, looking down at his food during dinner.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh mujhse nazrein churata. Baat bhi nahi karta tha.
scenes.sub: He avoided my gaze. Didn't even talk.
scenes.say: वो मुझसे नज़रें चुराता। बात भी नहीं करता था।

scenes.image: Priya looking distressed, holding her head in her hands, sitting alone on her bed.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mera dil tootne laga. Kya woh jaa raha tha?
scenes.sub: My heart started breaking. Was he leaving?
scenes.say: मेरा दिल टूटने लगा। क्या वो जा रहा था?

scenes.image: Priya confronting Rohan, her arms crossed, looking serious. Rohan avoids her gaze, looking uncomfortable.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine use pucha, 'Rohan, kya ho raha hai hamare beech?'
scenes.sub: I asked him, 'Rohan, what is happening between us?'
scenes.say: मैंने उसे पूछा, 'रोहन, क्या हो रहा है हमारे बीच?'

scenes.image: Rohan looking stressed, running a hand through his hair, his face clouded with worry and guilt.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Priya, please trust me. Kuch personal kaam hai, bas.
scenes.sub: Priya, please trust me. It's just some personal work.
scenes.say: प्रिया, प्लीज ट्रस्ट मी। कुछ पर्सनल काम है, बस।

scenes.image: Priya staring at Rohan, her eyes narrowing with doubt, feeling betrayed despite his words. Tears well up.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Trust? Mujhse kuch chupa raha tha woh. Sach nahi bolta.
scenes.sub: Trust? He was hiding something from me. Not telling truth.
scenes.say: ट्रस्ट? मुझसे कुछ छुपा रहा था वो। सच नहीं बोलता।

scenes.image: Close-up of Priya's face, a single tear running down her cheek, heartbroken expression.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe laga woh mujhe chhod dega. Ya kisi aur ke saath.
scenes.sub: I thought he would leave me. Or with someone else.
scenes.say: मुझे लगा वो मुझे छोड़ देगा। या किसी और के साथ।

scenes.image: Priya secretly checking Rohan's phone while he's asleep, her face illuminated by the screen, looking guilty and desperate.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe shak tha, shayad kisi aur se milta tha.
scenes.sub: I suspected, maybe he was meeting someone else.
scenes.say: मुझे शक था, शायद किसी और से मिलता था।

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan's text messages: 'Milte hai sham ko, theek hai? Budget manage ho gaya.' Priya's hand trembles.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh kya tha? 'Milte hai shaam ko'. Budget? Kisse?
scenes.sub: What was this? 'Meet in the evening'. Budget? With whom?
scenes.say: ये क्या था? 'मिलते है शाम को'। बजट? किससे?

scenes.image: Priya looking determined and heartbroken, making a decision, wiping a tear from her eye. Close-up.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Bas, ab aur nahi. Maine peecha karne ka faisla kiya.
scenes.sub: Enough, no more. I decided to follow him.
scenes.say: बस, अब और नहीं। मैंने पीछा करने का फैसला किया।

scenes.image: Rohan leaving the house early morning, looking furtive, carrying a small toolkit bag. Priya peeking from behind a curtain.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Subah jaldi woh nikla, chhup-chhup kar. Har roz.
scenes.sub: Early morning he left, stealthily. Every day.
scenes.say: सुबह जल्दी वो निकला, छुप-छुप कर। हर रोज़।

scenes.image: Priya quickly gets ready, putting on a simple disguise (dupatta covering her head), looking determined.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main bhi uske peeche, apni pehchan chhupa kar.
scenes.sub: I also followed him, hiding my identity.
scenes.say: मैं भी उसके पीछे, अपनी पहचान छुपा कर।

scenes.image: Priya in an auto-rickshaw, keeping a discreet distance, watching Rohan walk ahead in a crowded street. Anxious face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Pehle ek auto, phir dusra. Uske peeche-peeche.
scenes.sub: First one auto, then another. Following him.
scenes.say: पहले एक ऑटो, फिर दूसरा। उसके पीछे-पीछे।

scenes.image: Rohan boarding a local bus, looking around cautiously. Priya quickly gets into another bus behind him, out of sight.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne bus li, main bhi usi bus mein chadh gayi.
scenes.sub: He took a bus, I also got onto the same bus.
scenes.say: उसने बस ली, मैं भी उसी बस में चढ़ गई।

scenes.image: Priya peeking over a seat, watching Rohan staring out the window, lost in thought, looking stressed.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Har pal, mera dil tez dhadak raha tha. Kya dekhenge?
scenes.sub: Every moment, my heart was beating fast. What will I see?
scenes.say: हर पल, मेरा दिल तेज़ धड़क रहा था। क्या देखेंगे?

scenes.image: The bus journey through rural landscapes, showing village fields and distant houses. Rohan is still looking out the window.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Shahron se door, gaon ki taraf. Wahi raasta.
scenes.sub: Away from cities, towards the village. The same road.
scenes.say: शहरों से दूर, गाँव की तरफ। वही रास्ता।

scenes.image: Rohan getting off the bus at a dusty village stop, looking around, then walking down a narrow lane towards old buildings.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh gaon mein utra, usi gaon mein jahan mera sapna tha.
scenes.sub: He got off in the village, the same village where my dream was.
scenes.say: वो गाँव में उतरा, उसी गाँव में जहाँ मेरा सपना था।

scenes.image: Priya, hiding behind a cart, watching Rohan approach the old, dilapidated building she once showed him.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh ussi purani building ki taraf gaya. Dil darr se bhara.
scenes.sub: He went towards that same old building. Heart filled with fear.
scenes.say: वो उसी पुरानी बिल्डिंग की तरफ गया। दिल डर से भरा।

scenes.image: Close-up of Priya's face, wide-eyed with shock and confusion, a gasp escaping her lips as Rohan enters the building.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kya? Woh yahan kya kar raha tha? Ye mera gaon hai!
scenes.sub: What? What was he doing here? This is my village!
scenes.say: क्या? वो यहाँ क्या कर रहा था? ये मेरा गाँव है!

scenes.image: Priya cautiously approaching the building's entrance, seeing the door slightly ajar. Her hand trembles as she pushes it open.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dil mein darr liye, maine darwaza khola.
scenes.sub: With fear in my heart, I opened the door.
scenes.say: दिल में डर लिए, मैंने दरवाज़ा खोला।

scenes.image: Inside the building, Rohan is sweeping dust, surrounded by construction tools. Other villagers are helping him. He's covered in dust.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Andar ka nazara dekh kar meri saansein ruk gayi.
scenes.sub: Seeing the sight inside, my breath stopped.
scenes.say: अंदर का नज़ारा देख कर मेरी साँसें रुक गई।

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan, covered in dust, wiping sweat from his brow, but with a determined, hopeful look. He's mixing cement.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh jhadu laga raha tha, paseene mein latpat. Mazdoori?
scenes.sub: He was sweeping, drenched in sweat. Labour?
scenes.say: वो झाड़ू लगा रहा था, पसीने में लथपथ। मज़दूरी?

scenes.image: Priya looking around the dilapidated room, seeing old books piled in a corner, and a freshly painted wall. A blueprint is on a table.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Nayi deewar, kuch kitaabein, aur ek blueprint.
scenes.sub: New wall, some books, and a blueprint.
scenes.say: नई दीवार, कुछ किताबें, और एक ब्लूप्रिंट।

scenes.image: Close-up of the blueprint, clearly showing a small, cozy library layout with bookshelves and reading nooks.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh toh wahi blueprint tha jo maine socha tha!
scenes.sub: This was the same blueprint I had imagined!
scenes.say: यह तो वही ब्लूप्रिंट था जो मैंने सोचा था!

scenes.image: Rohan looking up, startled, as he sees Priya standing at the doorway, his face a mix of surprise and slight panic.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Priya? Tum yahan? Tumhe yeh sab nahi dekhna chahiye tha.
scenes.sub: Priya? You here? You shouldn't have seen all this.
scenes.say: प्रिया? तुम यहाँ? तुम्हें यह सब नहीं देखना चाहिए था।

scenes.image: Priya's face, eyes wide, a mix of shock, confusion, and a dawning realization. Her mouth slightly open, tears forming.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh kya tha? Main kuch samajh nahi pa rahi thi. Kya ho raha hai?
scenes.sub: What was this? I couldn't understand anything. What is happening?
scenes.say: यह क्या था? मैं कुछ समझ नहीं पा रही थी। क्या हो रहा है?

scenes.image: Rohan walking towards Priya, hands covered in dust, a gentle, apologetic smile on his face, a little nervous.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Sorry Priya, main tumhe surprise karna chahta tha. Pura surprise.
scenes.sub: Sorry Priya, I wanted to surprise you. A complete surprise.
scenes.say: सॉरी प्रिया, मैं तुम्हें सरप्राइज करना चाहता था। पूरा सरप्राइज।

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan's hands, worn and calloused, holding a small, hand-drawn sketch of the library, identical to Priya's childhood drawing.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne wahi sapna yaad dilaya jo maine bhula diya tha.
scenes.sub: He reminded me of the dream I had forgotten.
scenes.say: उसने वही सपना याद दिलाया जो मैंने भुला दिया था।

scenes.image: Rohan looking at the old building, then back at Priya, his eyes full of earnestness.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Yeh hamara sapna tha. Main isse pura karna chahta tha.
scenes.sub: This was our dream. I wanted to fulfill it.
scenes.say: यह हमारा सपना था। मैं इसे पूरा करना चाहता था।

scenes.image: Priya looking at Rohan with tears streaming down her face, guilt and overwhelming love on her face. She reaches out.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur main uspe shak kar rahi thi. Kitni galat thi main.
scenes.sub: And I was doubting him. How wrong I was.
scenes.say: और मैं उसपे शक कर रही थी। कितनी गलत थी मैं।

scenes.image: Rohan gently takes Priya's dusty hand, looking into her eyes with tenderness, wiping her tears with his thumb.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Tumhari aankhon mein woh chamak dekhni thi. Yeh tumhara hai.
scenes.sub: I wanted to see that sparkle in your eyes. This is yours.
scenes.say: तुम्हारी आँखों में वो चमक देखनी थी। यह तुम्हारा है।

scenes.image: Priya burying her face in Rohan's dusty shoulder, hugging him tightly, sobbing softly, a mix of relief and regret.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main uske gale lag gayi, bohot roya. Maafi mangi.
scenes.sub: I hugged him, cried a lot. Apologized.
scenes.say: मैं उसके गले लग गई, बहुत रोया। माफी माँगी।

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan, hand-in-hand, standing in the middle of the now clean and painted room. Bookshelves are visible, some new furniture.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Phir humne milkar kaam kiya. Har din, hamare sapne ke liye.
scenes.sub: Then we worked together. Every day, for our dream.
scenes.say: फिर हमने मिलकर काम किया। हर दिन, हमारे सपने के लिए।

scenes.image: Rohan painting a wall, Priya arranging books on a shelf, both smiling happily at each other, covered in a bit of paint.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mera sapna, ab hamara sapna tha. Uska sacrifice.
scenes.sub: My dream, now it was our dream. His sacrifice.
scenes.say: मेरा सपना, अब हमारा सपना था। उसका सैक्रिफाइस।

scenes.image: Close-up of a small, elegantly hand-painted sign: 'Priya's Pustakalaya' (Priya's Library) over the entrance.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne uska naam bhi mere naam par rakha. Mere samman mein.
scenes.sub: He even named it after me. In my honor.
scenes.say: उसने उसका नाम भी मेरे नाम पर रखा। मेरे सम्मान में।

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan, proudly standing outside the beautifully renovated library, holding hands, looking at the sign. Children are gathering nearby.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Hamari library khul gayi. Gaon mein rounak aa gayi.
scenes.sub: Our library opened. The village became lively.
scenes.say: हमारी लाइब्रेरी खुल गई। गाँव में रौनक आ गई।

scenes.image: Children eagerly entering the library, looking excited, holding new books. Rohan and Priya watch them, smiling.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Bache khush the, bade bhi khush the. Hamara kaam.
scenes.sub: Children were happy, elders were also happy. Our work.
scenes.say: बच्चे खुश थे, बड़े भी खुश थे। हमारा काम।

scenes.image: Priya, sitting inside the library, reading a book to a group of attentive children, her face glowing with happiness.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Meri zindagi ka sabse khoobsurat chapter. Sach ho gaya.
scenes.sub: The most beautiful chapter of my life. Came true.
scenes.say: मेरी ज़िंदगी का सबसे ख़ूबसूरत चैप्टर। सच हो गया।

scenes.image: Rohan secretly watching Priya reading to kids, a soft, loving smile on his face, feeling proud and content.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur sab uske secret ki wajah se. Uska pyaar.
scenes.sub: And all because of his secret. His love.
scenes.say: और सब उसके सीक्रेट की वजह से। उसका प्यार।

scenes.image: Priya and Rohan sitting close together on a bench outside the library, looking content. Sun is setting over the village.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kuch secrets buray nahi hote. Kuch toh... pyaar hote hain.
scenes.sub: Some secrets are not bad. Some are... love.
scenes.say: कुछ सीक्रेट बुरे नहीं होते। कुछ तो... प्यार होते हैं।

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan's hand gently squeezing Priya's hand, a look of deep affection and understanding between them.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Tumhe khush dekh kar, main khush hoon. Hamesha.
scenes.sub: Seeing you happy, I am happy. Always.
scenes.say: तुम्हें खुश देख कर, मैं खुश हूँ। हमेशा।

scenes.image: Priya leaning her head on Rohan's shoulder, a serene smile on her face, looking out at the lively library.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine use galat samjha tha. Par usne mujhe galat sabit kiya.
scenes.sub: I had misunderstood him. But he proved me wrong.
scenes.say: मैंने उसे गलत समझा था। पर उसने मुझे गलत साबित किया।

scenes.image: Close-up of Priya's face, a gentle, reflective smile, eyes shining with love and gratitude.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kabhi kabhi, trust karna mushkil ho jaata hai. Par zaroori.
scenes.sub: Sometimes, trusting becomes difficult. But necessary.
scenes.say: कभी-कभी, ट्रस्ट करना मुश्किल हो जाता है। पर ज़रूरी।

scenes.image: Priya's eyes looking directly at the camera, a thoughtful expression, a hint of a smile.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par saccha pyaar hamesha apna raasta dhoondh leta hai.
scenes.sub: But true love always finds its way.
scenes.say: पर सच्चा प्यार हमेशा अपना रास्ता ढूँढ लेता है।

scenes.image: Rohan and Priya smiling, holding hands, looking at the camera from the library doorway. Joyful expression.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kya aapne kabhi apne partner par aise shak kiya hai?
scenes.sub: Have you ever doubted your partner like this?
scenes.say: क्या आपने कभी अपने पार्टनर पर ऐसे शक किया है?

scenes.image: Priya (narrator) looking at the camera with a heartfelt expression.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aapne kab apne partner ko galat samjha?
scenes.sub: When did you misunderstand your partner?
scenes.say: आपने कब अपने पार्टनर को गलत समझा?

scenes.image: Text on screen: 'The Secret Library'. A final shot of the beautiful library exterior at sunset, children playing nearby.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Pyaar ke secret, sabse khoobsurat hote hain. Hai na?
scenes.sub: Love's secrets are the most beautiful. Aren't they?
scenes.say: प्यार के सीक्रेट, सबसे खूबसूरत होते हैं। है ना?
